# v0.10.0b2 — Tidy-up after the single service

- Breaking: **Activity** writes one logbook row per event and names what happened (`paused`, `release_disabled`, `vehicle_unplugged`, …); automations on `command_done`, `session_started`, `session_ended`, `wallbox_changed` or the `change` attribute need the new event types. A reload no longer repeats the last command.
- Removes code and documentation that nothing used any more, including the upgrade hints for versions before 0.10.0. The service state loses the unused field `choice_revision`.
- Checked against a real wallbox without a car: the service reads every register, keeps the heartbeat and clears error 200 on its own.

Update the app and the integration to **0.10.0b2** together.
